title: Qualify the actual gaps
prompt:
A sales intake requires need, budget, decision_owner and target_date. The buyer says: We need inventory reporting and must launch on 2026-11-01. No budget or decision owner is supplied.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. known: alphabetically sorted array of known field names; ask_about: sorted array of missing names.
remediation_hints: Ask only for material missing qualification data; do not invent budget or authority.
